recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic, kitsch-inspired digital collage featuring a central sunset gradient background, populated by disparate elements including a metallic flying saucer with a caricatured pilot, a giant shark head emerging from green water, and a man in a life raft surrounded by floating objects.
coreVisualRelationships: Disjointed scale between the giant shark and the small human figure
Outer space elements (UFO) juxtaposed with aquatic elements (shark, raft)
Vibrant, saturated color gradients contrasting with flat, cut-out photographic elements
coreInvariants: A central glowing sun on a dark horizon line
Heavy red outer glows on floating objects
Green stylized water splashes at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The shark head dominates the right foreground; the UFO occupies the upper left; the human figure is in the lower left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, open-mouthed shark head on the right provides the heaviest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large title at the top, down to the shark, across the water to the human figure, and up to the UFO.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central area above the horizon is relatively open, filled with a purple-to-red gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and red gradients form the sky and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lime green water and yellow-green text provide high-contrast highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red glows around the UFO and shark eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with a dark value base at the horizon line.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and heavy display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Tall, compressed vertical proportions for the main title
Heavy weight with slight rounded corners
Outer glows or drop shadows applied to all text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title text features a slight irregular 'wobble' or rough edge to simulate a printed novelty look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed sans-serif for primary information paired with blocky, warped display fonts for callouts.
graphicDevices: Red oval badges with white text
Halo effect around the pilot's head

preserve: Condensed verticality of the main title
The use of outer glows for legibility

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the main title.
Captures the 70s/90s novelty kitsch vibe for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal digital collage background. Top half is a purple-to-red gradient sky. Bottom half is a dark horizon with a glowing yellow sun. On the right, a giant stylized shark head with sharp teeth emerges from lime-green splashing water. On the left, a man in a life raft with records and a microphone. Floating in the upper left is a metallic UFO with a cartoonish face in the cockpit. Apply a red outer glow to the UFO and shark.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large condensed sans-serif title in pale green at the top. Add secondary text in yellow-green below it. Place two red oval badges at the bottom corners containing arched white blocky text.

verificationChecks: Ensure the shark head is significantly larger than the human figure.
Check that the red outer glow is visible around the UFO.
Verify the gradient transitions smoothly from purple to red.
Confirm the text has a soft glow to separate it from the busy background.

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the main title
postGenerationChecks: Is the composition appropriately chaotic and surreal?
Does the typography feel like a 90s novelty record cover?
Are the green water splashes vibrant and stylized?
Is the horizon line dark enough to ground the composition?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a cosmic gradient background with aquatic predators and small human figures in a digital collage style, topped with heavy condensed sans-serif typography featuring outer glows.
